# tbls50x30

The goal of tbls50x30 is to create display tables for monitoring 50x30
surveys.

## Installation

You can install the development version of tbls50x30 like so:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("arthur-shaw/tbls50x30")
```

# Package index

## Post-planting

- [`parcels_per_hhold()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/parcels_per_hhold.md)
  : Make parcels per household table
- [`parcel_gps()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/parcel_gps.md)
  : Make parcel GPS measurement table
- [`plots_per_parcel()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/plots_per_parcel.md)
  : Make plots per parcel table
- [`plot_use()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/plot_use.md)
  : Make plot use table
- [`plot_gps()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/plot_gps.md)
  : Make plot GPS measurement table
- [`crops_per_plot()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/crops_per_plot.md)
  : Make crops per plot table
- [`crop_types()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/crop_types.md)
  : Make crop types tables

## Post-harvest

- [`temp_crop_harvest()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/temp_crop_harvest.md)
  : Create temporary crop harvest table
- [`temp_crop_sales()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/temp_crop_sales.md)
  : Create temprorary crop sales table
- [`perm_crop_harvest()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/perm_crop_harvest.md)
  : Create permanent crop harvest table
- [`perm_crop_sales()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/perm_crop_sales.md)
  : Create permanent crop sales table
- [`livestock_ownership()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/livestock_ownership.md)
  : Create livestock ownership table
- [`cow_displacement()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/cow_displacement.md)
  : Create cow displacement table
- [`hen_displacement()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/hen_displacement.md)
  : Create hen displacement table
- [`anim_prod_sales()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/anim_prod_sales.md)
  : Produces table for sales and production of milk or eggs
- [`other_prod_sales()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/other_prod_sales.md)
  : Create table on product production and sales
- [`process_crop_prod()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/process_crop_prod.md)
  : Create stats on crop processing
- [`crop_labor()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/crop_labor.md)
  : Create crop labor table
- [`livestock_labor_tbl()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/livestock_labor_tbl.md)
  : Create livestock labor table
- [`sector_labor()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/sector_labor.md)
  : Create table for sector labor
- [`income_sources()`](https://arthur-shaw.github.io/tbls50x30/reference/income_sources.md)
  : Create table of income sources
